Subject: Novalabs — prep for Q4 growth readiness check-in

Team,

Quick alignment ask for Novalabs ahead of our cadence call (Wed 12/22):

- Can CS and RevOps update the HubSpot deal HB-4391 with the latest stage and expected close window? Finance wants a conservative lift number by EOD Wednesday so we can include it in the weekly forecast deck.

I'll run a short 30-min sync on Wednesday — invite to follow. If you have blockers (legal/pricing questions) flag them here so I can loop in Edmund.

Attachments: account_health_template.xlsx

Thanks,
